children.name: FAQ Kicker
children.characters: Details regarding identity verification and next steps.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Do I need a company to verify as a Creator?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Creator verification happens before company incorporation.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Why do I need identity verification?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: It helps establish a trusted person behind the Creator profile.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: No public visibility should be implied for verification documents.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Does being verified mean Mondial approves my project?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Identity verification confirms the Creator identity, not the commercial validity of the project.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can I update my profile later?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Yes. Profile information can evolve as the Creator journey progresses.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: The Creator moves into Project Identity & Branding to begin structuring the project.
